first: Another traveler… The island has been waiting for you.

first.speaker: Nico
first.text: Where am I? My compass is broken and I need to get home.

first: If you want to find the way back, you'll first have to learn to listen to the island.
The forest keeps something that belongs to you. But not everything it guards wants to be found.
again: The Guardian watches over the heart of the forest, at the end of the path.
Its roots will slow you down. If you defeat it, the island may lend you its strength.
And remember: the island watches how you fight.

final.speaker: Nico
final.text: I did it. The green fragment… the compass is shining again.

final: One of three. The Mountain Ruins hold the next one.
Be careful. The island learns from you more than you think.
